questions.question: A certain amount is lent at x% p.a. simple interest for 3 years. questions.question: Varun and Madhur invested ₹25,000 each in different schemes, Varun earned simple interest at 11% per annum, whereas Madhur earned compound interest at 10% per annum compounds. Who received more interest after 2 years and how much? वरुण और मधुर ने अलग - अलग योजनाओं में ₹ 25,000 निवेश किए , वरुण ने 11% प्रति वर्ष की दर से साधारण ब्याज अर्जित किया , जबकि मधुर ने 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज अर्जित किया। 2 वर्ष बाद किसे अधिक ब्याज मिला और कितना ?

Varun and Madhur invested ₹25,000 each in different schemes, Varun earned simple interest at 11% per annum, whereas Madhur earned compound interest at 10% per annum compounds. Who received more interest after 2 years and how much?

questions.solution:
Rate for Varun , 2 years at 11% on Simple interest = 22%
And Net rate for Madhur, 2 years at 10% on Compound interest = 21%
Difference in interest = 22-21=1%
⇒ 25,000 ×1% = ₹250
Varun earned ₹250 more.
 वरुण के लिए दर, 2 वर्ष 11% पर साधारण ब्याज = 22%
और मधुर के लिए शुद्ध दर, 2 वर्ष 10% पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज = 21%
ब्याज में अंतर = 22-21=1%
⇒ 25,000 × 1% = ₹250
वरुण ने ₹250 अधिक कमाए।
